At the next weekly cycle, verify legitimate data access and historical coverage before evaluating the new fundamental proposals; record unavailable sources rather than bypassing403 or manufacturing histories.
Require at least three economic factor families and unchanged Sharpe/SPY/drawdown gates before advancing a research version; no qualified current champion exists.
Seek verifiable historical execution or publication-time fundamental data for new hypotheses; do not retune the near-threshold band on the same exposed history.
Keep candidate rules frozen and obtain genuinely new timestamped forward observations before any trading promotion; do not backfill or restart paused ledgers implicitly.
Retain higher-cost and rolling-window failures as open robustness limitations, not hidden exceptions or reasons to rewrite frozen evidence.
Publish only date-aligned, timestamped and hash-verified watch evidence; never relabel old signals.
Compare identical windows, costs and Sharpe definitions before comparing strategies.
Preregister bounded hypotheses and preserve failures and the paused forward record.
